summary: iter160 Team Score regression (UI first). PASS: 112 visible schema columns plus bulk/Status/Actions (115 th); I and J hidden; H relabelled 'Email / Teams ID'; K shows 'LinkedIn Profile' (16 View Profile links, target=_blank); header tooltips carry the full Excel title; headers wrap to at most 2 lines with the letter label; sort cycle asc (cyan up), desc (cyan down), unsorted (grey) works and restores the default order; Name sort is correct across all 183 rows and all 4 pages; S.no sorts numerically; joining dates sort chronologically; employee bulk select (3) shows the bar and modal, then Cancel and Clear work; Add New Team Round modal opens and closes. The Admin Import Review delete UI was verified with MOCKED /unnamed data via Playwright route interception, with every mutation aborted: Select-All, per-row checkboxes, Actions trash icon, single-delete modal (Source Row/Team/Status/Role/Email/Notes), Cancel, the amber bar 'N review rows selected · Delete Selected · Clear Selection', the indeterminate state and the bulk modal with Cancel all work. FAIL: multi-select chips never filter the table (employee_ids is never sent); chip label text is invisible; a filter race condition. DATA NOTE: the real preview DB (hr_analytics) has 0 unnamed review rows, not 2. They were hard-deleted by a concurrent client (backend.out.log line 39176, POST /api/team-score/unnamed/bulk-delete 200) before my testing began. One round was also deleted by a concurrent client (log line 39236, DELETE /api/team-score/rounds/6afdbd236326e9c8bd67ffcb 200), so rounds went from 96 to 95. Neither came from this tester: all my browser sessions blocked or recorded mutations and recorded none, and my live pytest only hits unknown or malformed ids. Employees are still 183.

minor.issue: Scratch DBs are never dropped. The local mongo holds 100+ leftover ts_*_pytest_scratch_* databases. Add a teardown that runs drop_database.

ui_bugs.issue: Selecting suggestions adds chips, but the table and badge stay at 183 / 183, even after Apply. fetchAll never appends employee_ids=<csv of selected ids> (only a comment refers to it). The backend supports it (employee_ids=<id> returns 1). This has been missing since iter158 (3a0b15a).
Chip label text is invisible: the computed color and background are both rgb(207,250,254), so the light-theme override maps the text and background to the same colour.

Race condition. On mount, GET /employees fires twice with no request-sequence guard, so a late stale response can overwrite filtered results. In 1 of 2 runs, Status=inactive + Apply sent the correct query but the badge showed 183 / 183. Reset uses setTimeout(fetchAll,0) while filtersRef is updated in a useEffect, so Reset can fetch with stale filters: once, the badge stayed at '1 / 183' after Reset. Fix: pass filters explicitly, or use an AbortController / request-id guard.

The dropdown stays open after you pick a suggestion and covers the filter row. The Apply button cannot be clicked because the li intercepts pointer events. The outside-click handler does not fire because Apply sits inside searchBoxRef. Only Escape closes it.

Surya J's joining date is stored as the Excel serial 46241. It renders as '46241' instead of DD-MM-YYYY (07-08-2026) and sorts as missing (last). fmtDateCell / parseDateForSort do not handle Excel serials.
colSpan is columnSchema.length+2 (116), but 115 columns render because I and J are hidden. This is cosmetic.
data-testid='ts-filter-team' is duplicated on the FilterField wrapper div and on the select, so a strict locator resolves 2 elements. The other filters use '-wrap' on the wrapper.

integration_issues.issue: The frontend never sends employee_ids, so chips have no effect on the data (see ui_bugs).

Handle Excel serial dates (e.g. 46241) in fmtDateCell / parseDateForSort.

Investigate who deleted the 2 Admin Import Review rows (log line 39176) and round 6afdbd236326e9c8bd67ffcb (log line 39236) in the preview DB during this window. Re-import the workbook if those rows and the round are needed.
Add drop_database teardown to the scratch-DB pytest suites.
critical_code_review_comments: TeamScore.js is 1550 lines and should be split (header/table, AdminImportReview, modals, sort helpers).
getSortValue rebuilds the raw_columns map for every comparison (O(n log n × cols)). Precompute a map per employee once, keyed by sortState.
nameIdx is recomputed with findIndex inside every header and every row render loop. Memoize it.
Date detection relies on the header regex \bdate\b|doj|dob. Headers such as 'Dates' or 'DOJ.' work, but a 'Joined On' style header would not. Consider a schema type hint.
The conflict badge path (H≠I) was verified only by code review. The live DB has 0 conflicts, and my mock patch of /employees failed with a 401 from route.fetch.
